content.text:
* Two-stage CMOS OTA with low-current supply-ripple cancellation pair
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XTAIL TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=1 m=1
XBIASN PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XPBIAS PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=1
XPOUT VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=10
XMNOUT VOUT N2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=5
XINN N1 VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 m=1
XINP N2 VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 m=1
XPM1 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=2
XPM2 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=98.5 l=1 m=2
* A small differential pair adds a feedforward supply current.
XATAIL TAILA IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=1 m=1
XAP1 N1 AG1 TAILA VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=1 m=1
XAP2 N2 AG2 TAILA VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=1 m=1
R1A VDD A1 100meg
R1B A1 AG1 100meg
R1C AG1 A2 100meg
R1D A2 VSS 100meg
R2A VDD A3 100meg
R2B A3 AG2 100meg
R2C AG2 A4 100meg
R2D A4 VSS 100meg
CAG1 AG1 VSS 15.5p
RZ N2 NC 1500
CC NC VOUT 4.5p
.ends DUT
